text: Today I was at work for most of the day. It was so slow and boring, no one came in and I was there just waiting for the full 7 hours. I think we had like less than 20 people come in. I at least had time to work on projects the whole time was able to type out a bunch of text samples, which saved me time later not having to do it. After work I still had more to work on but at least the tedious writing of samples was done.
